Our Story

Casual dining, fast-food soul.

Right on the Ambala-Chandigarh Highway, near UCO Bank in Lalru Mandi, Italian Haweli has become the go-to table for anyone craving stretchy cheese and bold flavour without the fuss. Wood-fired pizzas, pasta, momos, shakes and the house Spicy Achaari Pizza keep the regulars coming back — and a warm Lava Cake keeps them staying a little longer.

We started as a small counter serving students and families on their way through the market, and stayed casual on purpose — quick tables, honest prices, and a kitchen that doesn't cut corners on cheese. Everything's made to order, whether you're stopping in for a slice or booking the corner table for a birthday.

Menu Highlights

Signatures worth the trip.

A short list of what Lalru actually orders — cheesy pizzas, creamy pasta and a couple of things to cool down with.

Bestseller

Margarita Pizza

from ₹130

Single cheese, house tomato base — the simple one that sells out first. Regular ₹130 · Medium ₹250 · Large ₹500.

Signature · Spicy

Spicy Achaari Pizza

from ₹170

Jalapeno, red pepper and corn on a pickle-spiced base. Regular ₹170 · Medium ₹350 · Large ₹650.

House Favourite

Makhan Pasta

₹120

Buttery, mildly spiced pasta — comfort food, Lalru-style. Tandoori Pasta also on the menu at ₹120.

Street-Style

Fried Momos

₹80

Crisp-fried dumplings from the Chinese menu — a favourite starter before the pizza arrives.

Refreshment

Sweet mango, a kick of chilli-lime, and enough ice to survive the Lalru afternoon.

Dessert

Lava Cake with Ice Cream

Warm, dense, and molten in the middle — the table always splits one more. Plain Lava Cake also available at ₹100.
